run:
import importlib.util,json,sys,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
r=json.load(sys.stdin)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('flow_guard',Path('taskflows/guard.py'))
g=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(g)
c,t,h=g.candidate('P1','p1-001')
assert all(r[k]['candidate_sha256']==h for k in ['technical','safety'])
backup=g.verified_backup()
blocked=any(r[k]['verdict']!='pass' or any(f['severity'] in ['blocker','major'] for f in r[k]['findings']) for k in ['technical','safety'])
result={'status':'REWORK' if blocked else 'PASS_OBJECTIVE','stage':'P1','session':'p1-001','candidate_sha256':h,'reviews':r,'pending_user_checks':t.get('pending_user_checks',[]),'user_subjective_acceptance_claimed':False,'authorization_source':'docs/执行授权-P1.json','live_configuration_written':False,'live_deployment_completed':False,'backup_source_unchanged':backup,'note':'Objective implementation/testing verdict only; not a fabricated user approval or product quality/performance acceptance.'}
out=Path('docs/验证/开发/p1-001/technical-status.json')
with out.open('x',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n') as stream: json.dump(result,stream,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
print(json.dumps({'status':result['status'],'candidate_sha256':h,'findings':[dict(f,reviewer=k) for k in ['technical','safety'] for f in r[k]['findings']],'pending_user_checks':result['pending_user_checks'],'record':out.as_posix(),'live_configuration_written':False},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
